gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

gripOrHq.title: Desperate Competitor
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you liberated any Gray Ops agendas this turn. Score 1 agenda point.

gripOrHq.title: Pile Driver
gripOrHq.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

gripOrHq.title: Hot Tip for WNS
gripOrHq.rulesText: Score 1 agenda point if you liberated any Black Ops agendas this turn.

gripOrHq.title: All-Nighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

gripOrHq.title: Romp through HQ
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

rig.title: Hammer
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Hammer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
